title: Source-reviewed routing corrections from the ROS waves
description: The selected environment contract determines the integration helper; a repository's ROS files do not turn its Gymnasium entry into a ROS wire interface.

overrides.justification: Turtlebot4Env is a concrete Gymnasium navigation environment with two action controls and structured observations. Preserve that task interface and explicitly address its ROS/Gazebo lifecycle.
The selected pinned URReachEnv is a six-action Gymnasium environment with reset/step over MuJoCo, not a ROS topic/service API. Keep its complete reach environment scope and use GymnasiumDriver.
The selected pure-Python PyBullet environment has a custom step/reset API without Gym spaces. A direct Driver preserves its arm and gripper controls; separate ROS utilities are not this entry.
The selected RoverEnv exposes Gymnasium reset/step and structured action/observation spaces; preserve navigation controls. Its internal ROS transport does not change the environment interface.
GDR2Env exposes a concrete Gymnasium force-control task. Preserve step/reset and validate Docker/ZeroMQ ownership and failure semantics before enabling a live backend.

MultiROS ships generic Gazebo/MoveIt utilities, two abstract environment bases and four incomplete templates; concrete tasks live elsewhere. It is a framework behind the ROS bridge, not a fabricated RL task.

The selected legacy Gym environment exposes three wheel actions and camera observations. A production wrapper must supply missing spaces and preserve native behavior; a fake alone is not that wrapper.
The selected RosSocialEnv has a PettingZoo parallel environment API. Preserve multi-agent controls with a shared Gymnasium adapter; ROS wire metadata alone does not integrate the environment.
